title: Story index (story.json)
description: The index of a story's logical files: episode, scene, UI, models, cue sheet directories and the media files of the kinds the episode uses. See docs/story-data-format.md.

models.description: Model address (the address the Character rows name) -> the model's id: its model.json is under live2d/<id>/ of the story's file set, its objects in the store's object table.

modelsDir.description: A story directory only (not a site): the directory holding the models (<modelsDir>/<id>/model.json, ...), relative to the story directory, "/"-separated.

crilips.description: The CRI Lips analysis data (docs/crilips.md): the descriptor (crilips.json) and the float32 weights (crilips.bin). null (or absent in older sites) when no voice of the story reaches the CRI Lips analysis.
